evidence: Read leaf n480 (stamp 476, hand 142) of 168036075_79_4_2, first document. Heading verbatim: '1784. - Junio 30 - S.ta Barb.a / Goicoechea á Fages, sobre abono á la Real Hacienda.' Author/recipient/place/date all match; foot-cite 'p. -326.-' and the hand page '142' both match orig_page 'p.IV 142 (p.326)'; stamp 476 matches savage_page. summary_fidelity WRONG on the sum: the leaf reads 'Acusa recibo de la carta de 3 de Junio, en la que se le dice debe abonarse á esa Habilitacion la cantidad de 203 pesos 6 r.s 11/12 g.s perten.tes á la Real Hac.a y los que deberán rebajarse en Thesoreria de esa comp.a' — i.e. 203p 6r 11/12g, not the catalogued '203p 3r 4½g'. Confirmed at scale=1 with a 3x crop: the reales digit is a looped 6 and the fraction is an unambiguous superscript 11 over 12. The record's direction is also loose (the sum is to be credited TO that habilitación, pertaining to the Real Hacienda, and deducted in that company's Tesorería). Omissions: n480 carries two documents (this and d351); both catalogued.

Read leaf n87 (stamp 88, pencil 87) of 168036075_79_5_2, second document. Heading verbatim: '1784 Junio 18 Loreto. / José J. de Arrillaga á Pedro Fages / Sobre observancia de Alcabalas'. Date, recipient, foot-cite 'p. 178' (= orig v.178) and stamp 88 (the ca3 convention — n120 stamp 121/hand 120 is catalogued 121, n87 stamp 88/hand 87 is catalogued 88) all match. place PARTIAL: the leaf states 'Loreto', which the record carries only inside the author string 'Arrillaga (Loreto)', leaving the place field blank. summary_fidelity WRONG on two data points: the leaf reads 'Previniendo de los 28 documentos de Alcabalas su observancia segun advierte en oficio de 9 de Dic.re de 83' — TWENTY-EIGHT, not the catalogued 22 (verified on a scale=1 crop; the second digit is a clear 8) — and the index's compiler is 'el Cap.n Ramon Oñate' (tilde visible over the n), not 'Ramón Ortega[?]'. The '(nos.1–25)' element is right: 'los q.e existian en el sur que son del N.o 1. al 25.' Omissions: n87 carries the tail of d81 (foot 'p.177'), this document, and the opening of d83 ('Publicacion de R.l Cedula'); all catalogued.

Read leaf n166 of 168036075_79_5_2, second document. Heading verbatim: '1785 Agosto 9 Sta Barbara / Felipe de Goicoechea á Pedro Fages. / Sobre vigilancia en la Conducta moral de los Indios'. Body: 'Dice: que queda impuesto por su oficio de 2 de Junio ultimo de celar con la mayor vigilancia de los individuos que se hallan bajo sus ordenes, quedando advertido al que contravenga que se le impondrá la mas rigorosa pena. Quedando advertidos los Sarjentos y Cabos de esta vigilancia, sin el menor disimulo, por que serán comprehendidos en la misma pena.' Foot-cite reads 'p. 334 = 335.' — so the out-of-sequence orig_page 'v.334–335' is Savage's own and is recorded correctly (not the transposition it looks like). savage_page WRONG: the printed stamp at the head of n166 is 164 (pencil 163 above it, verified on a magnified crop); the record's 163 is the pencil foliation, contrary to this volume's own convention — n87 is catalogued 88 (stamp) not 87, n120 is catalogued 121 (stamp) not 120, and the very next leaf n167 (stamp 165 / pencil 164) is catalogued 165. The defect also affects d193–d195. place PARTIAL: 'Sta Barbara' is on the leaf but recorded only as '(SB)' inside the author field. Omissions: n166 carries two documents (d195, d196), both catalogued.

Leaf read: 168036075_79_9_2 n344 (printed stamp '340'; copyist's own page '(126.)' written at head, which is what savage_page records, correctly). Heading verbatim: '1795. = Junio 19 = México. / Branciforte á Borica, sobre remision de Artesanos á esta Península.' Foot: 'pp. 297 = 299'. Author, recipient, date, orig_page, savage_page and scan pin all confirmed. PLACE = PARTIAL: the leaf gives 'México' as the place of writing but the place column is empty, the datum surviving only as a parenthesis in the author string. SUMMARY = WRONG: the abstract presents a verbatim quotation that the leaf does not support. The catalogue prints Savage's note as 'ya se tomó nota á consecuencia de fojas 241 á 243… y de foja 168 á 172. Esta es copia'. The leaf reads, in full and unambiguously at high magnification: '(De este documento ya se tomó nota y corre de fojas 241 á 243 del mismo volúmen, y de fojas 108 á 112 de esta copia = Copista.)' Three departures: 'y corre de' becomes 'á consecuencia de'; 'de fojas 108 á 112 de esta copia' becomes 'de foja 168 á 172'; 'de esta copia = Copista' becomes 'Esta es copia'. The misread figure matters, because 108 á 112 is precisely the Savage pagination of Doc 433 (recorded in the catalogue itself as sav (108)-(112), orig xiii.241-243), so Savage's note points at one location only, not two, and the bracketed gloss '[= Docs 373 & 433]' adds a cross-reference the leaf does not make. The duplicate finding itself is sound. Omissions OK: the leaf's first entry (the carpenter José Antonio Ramírez, pp. 295-296) is ca7-d448.

Leaves read: 168036075_79_9_2 n478 through n483. n478 = stamp '473', hand '259.'; n483 = stamp '478', hand '264.', so the span n478-n483 and savage (259)-(264) are both exact, and n483 foots 'pp = 585 = 90', matching orig_page xiii.585-590. Date confirmed: '1795 = Octubre 1.o = San Diego.' RECIPIENT = WRONG. The catalogue records '[Nava]' as an inference; the leaf heading states the addressee outright: 'Grajera á Borica, sobre visita á la Mision de San Miguel.' PLACE = PARTIAL (leaf 'San Diego', place column empty, folded into author as '(SD)'). SUMMARY = WRONG on four discrete data points. (1) 'left London 1 Nov 1793': leaf n482 reads 'dicha Fragata salió de Londres el día 14 de Nov. de 93 fletada por el Rey Británico' (the '14' is unambiguous at high magnification). (2) '110 arrobas flour': leaf n482 reads '3 reses, 6 castrados, 40 arrobas de harina, 24 gallinas, 6 @ de cebolla, algunas calabazas, 15 fan.s de Maíz, 6 fan.s de frijol, 4 de sal' (forty, not a hundred and ten). (3) 'boarding party ashore (captain + English interpreter + 2 Black crew)': leaf n481 reads 'donde encontré dos tan solamente en tierra y los demas todos en la Lancha… me respondieron que el Capitan del barco y un marinero que le servía de intérprete y éste era un negro' (two men ashore, the captain and one Black sailor-interpreter, not four). (4) '300 barrels sperm & oil': leaf n483 reads 'y que llevaban 5[0 struck through] barriles de esperma y aceite'; whatever the cancelled digit, there is no '3' and no three-digit figure. Two further softer slips: the catalogue's 'provisioned it… against a bill in Cádiz/London' inverts the outcome, since the padres 'respondieron francamente que no necesitaban letra alguna para socorrer aquella necesidad que estaban prontos á darles lo que pidieran'; and the captain's name is silently normalised, the leaf reading 'su capitan se llama Juan Lochi'. The narrative frame (pedrero and horse into the estero, 'que caballo y cañon cayeron en el Estero; de suerte que el caballo murió [se ahogó] y el cañon no pudimos hacer uso de él, porque se llenó de agua', course for the Ensenada de Todos Santos, crew of 50 plus the officer's widow, Acapulco leg) is accurate. Omissions OK: n478's other entry (Arrillaga á Borica, 21 Aug 1795, relacion de Embarcaciones, pp. 583-84) is ca7-d604.

Leaves read: 168036075_79_10 n191, n192, n193, n194. SCAN_PIN = WRONG. Leaves read: 168036075_79_10 n228, n229, n230. SCAN_PIN = WRONG. n230 is stamped '236' (ink hand '39.') and carries two documents, neither of them a 31 March revista: '1797. Abril 11. Abril 10. Sta Barbara / Goycoechea á Borica. Se reparta armam.to a vecinos'. Leaves read: 168036075_79_10 n390 (stamp '391', ink hand '196') and n391 (stamp '392', ink hand '197'). savage_page 391 is exact, and all three diaries sit on n390 alone, footing pp 589-590, pp 591-4 and pp 595-8, so orig_page p.589-598 is exact. SCAN_PIN = PARTIAL: the document is on the first cited leaf, but the span overstates by one leaf, since n391 is wholly the next record's (three separate Ruiz-to-Borica letters, pp 599-600, 602-3, 604-5, catalogued as d378). DATE = WRONG: recorded '1797-02/04', but the headings read '1797 Feb 28 Pueblo de los Angeles', '1797 Feb. 16 Sta Barbara' and '1797 Ag.t 5 S.n Vicente'; the third is August, not April, so the true range is Feb-Aug. AUTHOR = PARTIAL: given names and ranks are dropped; the leaf reads 'Javier Alvarado', 'Pablo Cota' ('Su diario como alferez de la compañia de Sta Barbara') and 'Sarg.to José Fran.co Ruiz'. PLACE = PARTIAL (place column empty; the three places are folded into the author string). RECIPIENT = NA: these are submitted diaries with no addressee in any heading. SUMMARY = WRONG on two points, both inside what reads as a quotation. The leaf reads: 'Nada digno de mención excepto que Inocencio Mesa salió con su mujer el 11 de Julio y los gentiles lo mataron porque su padre antes havia matado algunos gentiles de este Valle.' First, 'lo mataron' is singular: only Mesa is said to be killed, not 'Mesa + wife murdered'. The catalogue's own d379 confirms it, recording that 'Mesa's widow identified the killer'. Second, the catalogue quotes 'un padre antes había matado algunos gentiles de este Valle'; the leaf plainly reads 'su padre', that is Mesa's own father, so the motive is a family vendetta, not a killing by a mission priest. That single letter reverses the meaning of the sentence. Omissions OK: n390 holds only these three diaries and all three are described.

Leaves read: 168036075_79_13_2 n221 and n222 (scale 2, plus scale-1 crops). Carcaba. / p. 509 - (dup)." DATE WRONG: the leaf reads "1802 - Mzo. 31", the record says 1803 Mar 31 (checked at scale 1: the year is unambiguously 1802). Leaves read: 168036075_79_13_2 n244, n245 and n246 (scale 2, plus a scale-1 crop of the date line). The document is the third entry on n245, headed "1803 - Set.e 24 - S.n Vicente. / Ruiz á Arrillaga. Estado de las Fronteras. / Participa no haber novedad en la tropa: fuga gral. de naturales de Mision de S.to Tomas, q.e no causó ningunos perjuicios; no haberse celebrado misa en aquella des- [n246] de el 17 de Mayo: revoluciones de indios p.r causa de pensar no se enviará jamás Misionero á S.to Tomas &c. / pp. 607-8." DATE WRONG: the leaf reads "Set.e 24" (24 September), not Nov 24 — verified on an enlarged scale-1 crop. SCAN_PIN WRONG: the record pins n244–245 and its ia_url points at n244, but n244 (printed stamp 243) carries two different documents — "1803 - Nov.e 5 - S.n Vicente / Ruiz á Fr. Juan Rivas ... p. 601" and "1803 - Nov.e 30 - S.n Vicente / Ruiz á Arrillaga. Nuevas declaraciones á dos reos ... pp. 602-3". The Estado de las Fronteras runs n245–n246. ORIG_PAGE WRONG: the leaf foots "pp. 607-8" (which the catalogue instead buried in the summary text); the recorded "p.241–42" is the pencil foliation of n245/n246. savage_page OK: the printed stamps on the two leaves that actually carry the document are 244 and 245, exactly as recorded — which is what shows the defect is in the scan index, not the savage page. summary_fidelity PARTIAL: substance right, but "desde el 17 de Mayo" attaches on the leaf to the mass not having been celebrated, not to the "revoluciones de indios", and the leaf makes the Indians' belief that no missionary will ever be sent the CAUSE of the disturbances ("p.r causa de pensar"), a link the abstract drops. place PARTIAL: place field blank, though S. Vicente is carried inside the author string. Omissions OK — every document on n244 and n245 is catalogued (d275, d274, d278, d276, d277).

Leaf read: 168036075_79_13_2 n294 (scale 2, plus a scale-1 crop of the operative line). Third entry: "1803 - Junio 10 - Mex / Iturrigaray á Gob. de Cals. Sueldo á un oficial. / Traslada órden R.l en q.e el Rey concede al Alferez de la Comp.ª de Cab.ª del Presidio de Loreto, en vista de su solicitud, el sueldo de Alabardero de la Guardia de d.cho Virey. / pp. 713-14". Leaf read: 168036075_79_14 n198 (scale 2, plus a scale-1 crop of the figure). Second entry: "1807. Set.e 26. Méx. / Iturrigaray - á Gob. de Cal.s - Sobre el situado. / Le comunica que con esta f.ha escribió al Habilitado Gen. avisándole haber dado órden á la Tesorería Gen.l p.ª que le entreguen $83,741. 5 r.s 4 g.s 'que se ha regulado corresponder á los presidios y piquete de artill.ª de la Alta Cal. p.ª la habilit.ª de sus Memorias del año próx.º' / pp 519-21". Leaf n272 (IA 168036075_79_14), printed stamp 269. Entry reads verbatim: '+ 1808. Dic. 5. Monterey. / Jose M.a Estudillo - / Recibo dado a Jose M.a Estrada, por saldo de cuenta de la habilitacion / p. 725. (Dup.)'. AUTHOR: field is blank although the underlined heading name (Savage's author slot, cf. the next entry on the same leaf 'Estudillo a Arrillaga') is 'Jose M.a Estudillo'. RECIPIENT: catalogue says 'Estudillo'; the leaf says the receipt was given 'a Jose M.a Estrada' - two different men, and the roles are inverted. Verified at high magnification: heading 'Estudillo', body 'Estrada'. PLACE: field empty but date_text carries 'Monterey', matching the leaf. DATE 1808-12-05, ORIG 'p. 725.', SAVAGE stamp 269 all confirmed. SUMMARY 'Receipt for the habilitacion balance. (Dup.)' is right in substance ('por saldo de cuenta de la habilitacion') but drops the one named party, Estrada - the same drop that corrupted the recipient field. OMISSIONS: the leaf's second entry (1809 Set. 20, 'Estudillo a Arrillaga', pp. 726-30) is covered by ca12-d328; nothing uncatalogued.

Leaves n333-n334 (IA 168036075_79_14), printed stamps 326 and 327. DATE IS WRONG: the heading reads '+ 1812. Set. 30 Sta Barb.a' - 30 September 1812, not the catalogued 1812-10-30. Checked at 2x crop; the word is 'Set.' with the long-s/t ligature, and the document itself concerns service that ended in January 1811, so no October date is in play. AUTHOR: leaf 'Cap.n Josef Arguello, Comand.te del Presidio'; catalogue 'Jose Arguello' identifies the right man (Josef = Jose is a legitimate expansion) but drops rank and office. RECIPIENT: the piece is a certification with no addressee named, so blank is correct. ORIG: leaf closes 'pp 1063 - 7' = catalogued '1063-7'. SUMMARY verified line by line against the leaf: 'Certifica que los milicianos de artill.a y los invalidos y vecinos de los Ang.s cooperaron en todo lo que se ofrecio de servicios cuando la revoluc.n de los indios cristianos y gentiles que intentaron atacar la mision de S.n Gabl. y el citado pueblo'; 'el cabo de aquellos milicianos Jose Bartolome Tapia, a mas de sus servic.s personales, ofrecio $150. - como donativo'; roster of cabos and soldados (Claudio Lopez, Bartolo Tapia, the Avilas, Verdugo, Higuera, Nieto...); 'Sirvieron desde 28 Oct. 1810 hasta 4 En.o 1811'; 'por orden del Sarg.to comisionado Guille Cota, hasta que los mando retirar el alferez Gab.l Moraga.' OMISSIONS: n334 also bears Savage's finding-aid note 'pp. 1070-1087 copias de documentos que ya se han estractado en pag.s anteriores de este tomo' - a note, not a document, so not counted as an omission; flagged for the record.

Leaf n174 (IA 168036075_79_15_2), printed stamp 175. Entry: '+ 1817 = Marzo 31. = S.n Francisco. / Manuel Gomez al Gob. Sola = Mal estado de los Artilleros. / Se queja de la escacez y mal estado de los artilleros de ese Presidio, pues todos estan invalidos y achacosos, al estremo que ha habido dia que no ha tenido con que relevar la bateria. / ps. 745-47.' PLACE: field blank and date_text ('1817-03-31') carries no place, though 'S.n Francisco' is on the leaf; PARTIAL because the datum sits (mislabelled) in the author field. DATE, ORIG 'ps. 745-47' = 'i.745-747', and stamp 175 confirmed. SUMMARY accurate including the verbatim quotation 'ha habido dia que no ha tenido con que relevar la bateria'. OMISSIONS: the leaf's other two entries (Palacio, 11 Jul 1817, ps. 736-38; Maria Antonia Pintado, 30 Jul 1817, ps. 739-40 y 744) are ca13-d212 and d213.

Leaves n215-n216 (IA 168036075_79_15_2), printed stamps 216 and 217. Heading: '1817 = Noviembre 18 = Monterey. / Sola a Luis Arguello = Pide informes sobre los buques exped.s y la cuenta de sus d.os.' AUTHOR: catalogue 'Monterey' is the place, not the author; the author is Sola (same systematic place-in-author defect as ca13-d214). RECIPIENT blank though the leaf reads 'a Luis Arguello' (summary carries it) - PARTIAL. PLACE blank though the heading is 'Monterey' - PARTIAL. SUMMARY: the Marquinez passage is exact - 'He sabido por el R.do P. Fr. Marcelino Marquivez que ha despachado V. una expedicion a las Rancherias de esas inmediaciones, cuyo motivo y resultado me dira V.d en primera ocasion' - but 'the foreign ships maneuvering at SF' is not on the leaf, which says only 'no me haya V. escrito sobre los buques que permanecian en ese Puerto, si han salido ya o permanecen, como asi mismo el producto que hubiese resultado de los efectos vendidos como el de los frutos extraidos'; neither 'foreign' nor 'maneuvering' is supported. DATE and stamps 216/217 confirmed. OMISSIONS: the other item on n216 (1817 Mayo 5, 'Lista de efectos tomados a Tarasoff e indios rusos y entregados a Teduiskin') is ca13-d273.

Leaf n58 (IA 168036075_79_16_2), printed stamp 59 with pencil 59. Heading: '+ 1801 - Mzo 11 - Loreto. / Arrillaga al Virrey de Mex. / (4 Docs) - pp. 146-8 -'. DATE: the year is 1801, not the catalogued 1804 - confirmed twice on the leaf ('Feb.o 11 - 1801 - ejecucion de Rosas p.r brutalidad y quema del cadaver de la mula') and corroborated by the neighbouring entries on n59 ('1801 - Abril 9 - Loreto', '1801 - Abril 21 - Loreto'), the first of which the catalogue itself dates 1801. PLACE: 'Loreto' is in the heading; the record has no place anywhere (place: '', places: [], date_text has none). SAVAGE_PAGE: recorded as an em-dash although the leaf bears stamp 59 (printed) and 59 (pencil); the same volume's later records (ca14-d415, d497) do record the stamp, so this is not a volume convention. SUMMARY is wrong on three counts: (1) the leaf reads 'el trabajo de 20 anos de la tropa, indios y vecinos, en composturas, construcciones &c es inutil p.r la precipitacion y fragilidad con q.e se hicieron' - TWENTY years, not '10 years' (verified at 2x; the glyph matches the 2 of '22' elsewhere and is not the two-stroke 1 of 'Mzo 11'); (2) the leaf says the works of BOTH presidios must be begun again - 'q.e cree es necesario q.e obras de Mont. y S.n Diego se principien de nuevo y con mas solidez' - the catalogue names only Monterey; (3) the gunpowder clause belongs to a DIFFERENT entry and misstates the unit - the leaf's next entry reads 'Mzo. 12. (4 Docs) - pp. 148-9. / - Remite espediente sobre falta de 64 saquillos polvora, al entregar bateria de Mont. Cabo Jo[se M.a Osorio]' - 64 SAQUILLOS (small sacks), not arrobas, and under 12 March at pp. 148-9, not under this 11 March document at pp. 146-8.
